rulesTestNames: lets managers list their organizer's duplicate candidates and nothing else
owner: Host read model projector: hostReadModels CRM view triggers
read: current organizer managers get a pair by id or list their organizer's pairs, newest evidence first, as listOrganizerContactMergeCandidates admitted them (requireOrganizerManager); a view not written yet reads as missing
write: server only; written from organizerContactIdentityClaims, organizerContactIdentityLinks, organizerContacts, organizerContactEventEdges and organizerContactMergeReviewDecisions
migrationNotes: Replaces listOrganizerContactMergeCandidates for the Host app (#2306): each pair exactly as the callable returned it, with reviewedByUid instead of the reader-specific canReopen. Merges and decisions stay on mergeOrganizerContacts and reviewOrganizerContactMergeCandidate, fenced by the contact and decision revisions on the row. The host-crm-views copy-forward migration creates views for pairs that predate the triggers.
Holds the two contacts' names, phone numbers and emails, which managers already read on hostContactSummaries; never identity hashes, linked uids or identity evidence.
